source_search.conclusion: Official code and a CSLR² checkpoint exist (preference level 1 expected for the CSLR² rows and for the InfoNCE baseline as a config variant). The cslr2 release contains no I3D inference code, no converter from BOBSL spotting releases to its prediction-pickle format, and no documented Swin-T classifier-head checkpoint, so the I3D and spotting rows would need preference-level-3 glue around third-party artifacts, and the Swin-8K row depends on whether bobsl.zip contains usable per-frame Swin predictions for test episodes (unverifiable before data access).

protocol_notes: Sec. 5.1 lists SENT-VAL/SENT-TEST as 20,870/1,973 sentences; Table 4 headers, App. D.2 and the BOBSL paper (Table 4: SENT-VAL_H 1,973; SENT-TEST 20,870) give the opposite assignment. Targets follow Table 4 and BOBSL.

Sec. 5.1 says CSLR-TEST corresponds to 4,950 test subtitles; Tables 1 and A.2 give 4,518 sentences. Sec. 4 says the annotations cover all 35 SENT-TEST episodes; the BOBSL paper lists 36 SENT-TEST episodes.
cslr2 README calls the retrieval test set the '25K manually aligned test set'; the paper calls SENT-TEST 20K.

Post-processing θ and m: paper Sec. 5.2 tunes them 'on unseen manually annotated CSLR sequences from the validation set'; frame_level_evaluation.py searches them on 0/train/*.csv unless test_search is set.

Checkpoint selection: paper App. A selects best T2V R@1 on manually aligned validation subtitles; upstream main.py passes best_t2v=-1 to log_and_save every epoch, so model_best.pth is the last epoch, and validation retrieval uses a random 2,000-sentence subset of the automatic subtitles file for val episodes.
Upstream exposes no command for SENT-VAL retrieval of a fixed checkpoint (test=True evaluates only public_test with manually aligned subtitles).
main.py test=True references rgb_lmdb_env, which is only opened when vis=True; vis=True opens the 1.5T RGB LMDB.

Training compute: paper/README report under 20 h on 4 x V100-32GB for 20 epochs (about 80 V100 GPU-hours) at batch size 512 per App. A, while config/dataloader batch_size is 128 per process (4 processes = 512). Recorded at gate compute-training-runs.

metric_definitions.aggregation: corpus level: sum of edit distances / sum of ground-truth lengths x 100, over CSLR-TEST subtitles with at least one lexical ground-truth segment (paper Sec. 5.1)

metric_definitions.implementation: utils/cslr_metrics.segment_iou per subtitle (reported as 'Segment IoU' by optimal_eval), synonyms counted correct

experiments.system: CSLR² (Ours) with optimal post-processing (†): 6-layer Transformer over frozen Video-Swin-T sign features, T5-large frozen text encoder, joint HN-NCE SentRet + SignRet training; CSLR by nearest-neighbour word retrieval over the 8K (8,697-word) vocabulary, then synonym combination, threshold θ and minimum repetition count m
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Paper App. A: checkpoint with best T2V R@1 on a manually aligned subset of validation subtitles. Upstream main.py does not carry best_t2v across epochs, so model_best.pth is overwritten every epoch; to be handled as a protocol item before any retraining. θ and m tuned on held-out manually annotated CSLR sequences (paper Sec. 5.2 says validation; code searches train CSVs).
